candidate_relations.reason: The reference requires myopericarditis with conduction-system involvement attributed to monkeypox infection plus concurrent Lyme disease. The candidate omits myocardial injury, conduction abnormalities, both etiologies, and Lyme coinfection, while also asserting an effusion despite cardiac MRI reporting no pericardial effusion.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Isolated acute pericarditis with effusion conflicts with the broader composite diagnosis and imaging state.
